title: The Morning Without Birds
logline: Nara and Jun investigate Calder Row's silent rooftops while a pressure advisory forces them to store water without mistaking clear, filtered, or boiled water for proven-safe water.
narrator_voice: A young woman in her mid-twenties narrating a dark survival story. Low, slightly husky, calm and tired, speaking close to the microphone like a late-night confession. American accent, natural, never theatrical.

characters.name: Nara Venn
characters.tags: young woman, 24, short black bob, fixed white streak at left temple, amber eyes, mustard scarf, charcoal courier jacket, silver triangle ear cuff, black cargo trousers
characters.voice: Low, intimate and direct, with restrained emotion.
characters.bio: A bike courier carrying an analog key and a warning recorded by her missing mother.

characters.name: Jun Arai
characters.tags: teenage girl, 17, feminine face, chin-length dense auburn curls, teal over-ear headphones around neck, yellow rain shell, narrow black gloves, analog wristwatch
characters.voice: Quick, precise and slightly breathless; technical ideas explained simply.
characters.bio: A Calder Row electronics apprentice who records strange signals and refuses to be dismissed as a child.

characters.name: Lio Calder
characters.tags: young boy, 14, short messy dark brown hair, round blue glasses, patched denim vest, red high-top shoes, constellation notebook
characters.bio: Nara's teenage neighbor, an observant note-taker who helps inventory Calder Row's emergency water.

negative: No gore, corpses, dead birds, zombies, bites, monsters, weapons, crowds, cropped faces, obscured eyes, extra limbs, duplicated characters, altered hairstyles, altered signature clothing, illegible text, misspelled captions, futuristic holograms, bright sunshine, comedy expressions or sexualized framing.
look: Vertical 9:16 cinematic anime realism, rain-dark blue-gray palette with mustard, yellow and red accents, detailed wet brick and metal, soft overcast morning light, grounded survival props, subtle copper highlights, expressive faces fully visible, restrained suspense, consistent character designs.
music: Five-minute dark ambient survival score: deep low drones, distant metallic textures, faint rain, almost no melody, slow heavy tension that sits quietly under narration. Five-minute instrumental suspense score with no vocals. Open with sparse bowed bass, distant glass harmonics and isolated piano notes beneath rain. Add muted water-drop percussion and soft analog pulses during the storage procedure. At 1:36 introduce a filtered low tone for the cloudy-water reveal. Build with restrained ticking textures and uneven electronic clicks as Jun tests the samples. At 3:12 align one deep pulse with the seventeen-second discovery, then shift into urgent hand percussion and tense strings for the final water choices. Strip the score back to bass, glass resonance and a faint electrical whine for the magnet test, ending on one sharp metallic sting and an unresolved sub-bass hum.

shots.framing: Medium-wide eye-level shot with Nara and Lio's faces fully visible beneath the emergency speakers.
shots.background: Rain-black rooftops, abandoned nests, empty power lines and speaker horns aimed at one blank patch of gray sky.
poses: Nara stares into the empty sky while Lio grips his notebook.
Nara shades her eyes and Lio looks along the vacant wires.
Nara catches one falling feather while Lio turns toward an empty nest.
Nara lowers the feather with a tense expression as Lio listens for birdsong.
shots.narration: I waited for the second siren. It never came. Neither did the birds.
shots.sfx: Light rain, distant rail groan, loose speaker bracket creak, complete absence of birdsong.

shots.framing: Medium two-shot with Nara and Lio's faces fully visible beside exposed plumbing.
shots.background: Wet brick stairwell entrance, vibrating water pipe, rooftop tanks and the empty skyline beyond.
poses: Nara raises her buzzing phone while Lio touches the trembling pipe; phone reads "PRESSURE LOSS: 9 MIN".
Nara studies the alert as Lio pulls his hand from the pipe; phone reads "PRESSURE LOSS: 9 MIN".
Nara looks toward the stairs while Lio opens his notebook; phone reads "PRESSURE LOSS: 9 MIN".
Nara pockets the phone and reaches for the door as Lio follows; phone still shows "PRESSURE LOSS: 9 MIN".
shots.narration: Below us, Calder Row's pipes groaned, and my phone gave the building nine minutes before pressure failed.
shots.sfx: Single phone buzz, pipe groan, water tank shudder, rain tapping metal.

shots.framing: Medium three-shot with Nara, Jun and Lio's faces fully visible at the open roof door.
shots.background: Dim stairwell, green service pipes, wet rooftop and empty power lines.
poses: Jun steps through the door holding a repair tin while Nara and Lio turn toward her.
Jun points downstairs with a gloved hand as Nara studies her and Lio closes his notebook.
Jun lifts an empty glass jar while Nara nods and Lio peers at it.
Jun leads toward the stairs as Nara and Lio move after her.
shots.narration: I met Jun at the roof door. She promised we could save water without trusting it blindly.
shots.sfx: Fast footsteps, stairwell echo, pipes knocking once, rain behind the door.

shots.framing: Medium-wide three-shot with all faces fully visible around a table of containers.
shots.background: Small brick apartment kitchen, steel sink, covered bottles, cooking pots and one stained utility bucket set apart.
poses: Nara places sealed drinks together while Jun separates the stained bucket and Lio watches.
Jun points at residue inside the bucket as Nara selects a clean food container and Lio takes notes.
Nara holds the clean container to the light while Jun folds her arms and Lio nods.
Nara and Jun move the clean containers toward the sink while Lio pushes the stained bucket away.
shots.narration: We started with sealed drinks, then chose clean food-grade containers—never buckets that had held paint, fuel, or cleaner.
shots.sfx: Containers sliding on wood, cabinet doors, faucet hiss, pipes rumbling.

shots.framing: Medium two-shot with Nara and Lio's faces fully visible above the container table.
shots.background: Steel sink, clean bottles, lidded food containers, tape and a dark radiator.
poses: Nara smells an empty container while Lio holds tape marked "DRINKING".
Nara checks a lid seal while Lio writes "WASHING" on another strip.
Nara turns a container to inspect a crack while Lio points at the damaged corner.
Nara rejects the cracked container as Lio places it away from the clean group.
shots.narration: I checked each container for residue, odor, cracks, and a tight lid while Lio marked its purpose.

line.text: Drinking or washing. No mystery bucket.

shots.sfx: Tape tearing, plastic lid clicks, faucet running unevenly.

shots.framing: Medium two-shot with Nara and Jun's faces fully visible between the sink and bathtub.
shots.background: Narrow tiled bathroom, clean covered bottles at the sink and an old bathtub beneath exposed pipes.
poses: Jun guides clear tap water into a covered bottle while Nara checks the lid.
Nara tightens the bottle cap as Jun watches the weakening stream.
Jun points toward the bathtub while Nara places the sealed bottle aside.
Nara starts filling the bathtub as Jun keeps the drinking bottles covered.
shots.narration: Jun sent the first clear run into covered bottles; I saved the bathtub only for flushing and cleaning.
shots.sfx: Running faucet, hollow bathtub splash, pipe vibration, lid snapping shut.

shots.framing: Medium two-shot with Nara and Jun's faces fully visible behind open pans and sealed bottles.
shots.background: Crowded counter, open cooking pans, compact lidded containers and rain-specked window.
poses: Nara reaches toward a large open pan while Jun raises one warning finger.
Jun points to dust on the pan rim as Nara looks closer.
Nara chooses a smaller bottle while Jun fits its lid.
Nara carries two sealed containers as Jun pushes the open pans aside.
shots.narration: Everyone downstairs wanted volume. We chose smaller containers we could seal, carry, and keep away from dust.
shots.sfx: Metal pan scrape, plastic caps turning, faint rain, uneven water flow.

shots.framing: Medium two-shot with Nara and Lio's faces fully visible beside the running sink.
shots.background: Steel faucet, row of capped bottles, wall clock and labeled tape.
poses: Nara screws a cap tight while Lio writes "7:26" on a tape label.
Lio sticks the time label on the bottle as Nara reaches for the next container.
Nara glances at the sputtering faucet while Lio braces the bottle.
Nara pulls a fresh glass under the tap as Lio watches the broken stream.
shots.narration: I capped the drinking water immediately and wrote the time. The tap had already begun to spit.
shots.sfx: Faucet sputter, clock tick, cap twist, pipe knock.

shots.framing: Medium close two-shot with Nara and Jun's faces fully visible behind a glass under the faucet.
shots.background: Steel sink, weakening tap, rain-dark window and sealed containers.
poses: Nara holds a glass beneath milky water as Jun leans closer.
Nara lifts the cloudy glass while Jun narrows her eyes.
Jun holds her palm behind the glass as Nara watches the suspended haze.
Nara starts to tip the glass away while Jun reaches to stop her.
shots.narration: But our next glass turned cloudy before the pressure dropped.
shots.sfx: Wet faucet cough, low pipe groan, glass clink, sudden drip.

shots.framing: Medium two-shot with Nara and Jun's faces fully visible beside the rain-lit window.
shots.background: Gray window light, kitchen counter, wall clock and the cloudy glass.
poses: Nara holds the glass over the sink while Jun catches her wrist gently.
Jun points to her analog watch as Nara sets the glass on the sill.
Nara holds the glass against the window while Jun starts timing.
Jun watches her second hand as Nara studies the cloud inside the glass.
shots.narration: I almost dumped it. Jun made me wait sixty seconds and hold the glass against the window.
shots.sfx: Analog watch tick, rain on glass, faucet dripping irregularly.

shots.framing: Medium close two-shot with both faces fully visible and the test glass large in the foreground.
shots.background: Rain-lit window, counter edge and blurred sealed bottles.
poses: Nara watches the lower water clear while Jun tracks the rising haze.
Jun points to the clear lower half as Nara leans closer.
Nara notices rust-colored grains on the bottom while Jun's expression tightens.
Jun lifts the glass carefully as Nara points at the settled grains.
shots.narration: I watched the haze clear from the bottom, but rust-colored grains stayed behind.
shots.sfx: Rain patter, faint glass ping, watch tick, distant plumbing knock.

shots.framing: Medium two-shot with Nara and Jun's faces fully visible over a cloth-lined container.
shots.background: Countertop test area, clean white cloth, cloudy sample and empty glass jar.
poses: Nara slowly pours the sample through the cloth while Jun steadies the jar.
Jun lifts the cloth edge as Nara peers at trapped orange grit.
Nara holds the clearer jar to the light while Jun points at particles still floating.
Jun lowers the jar with a firm expression as Nara studies the stained cloth.
shots.narration: We poured one sample through clean cloth. It caught visible grit, not whatever remained dissolved or too small to see.
shots.sfx: Water trickle through cloth, jar clink, fabric rustle.

shots.framing: Medium two-shot with Nara and Jun's faces fully visible beside the stove.
shots.background: Cold stove, metal pot, cloudy sample jar and weakening faucet.
poses: Nara reaches for the pot while Jun places one gloved hand on its lid.
Jun points from the cloudy jar to the pot as Nara pauses.
Nara looks into the sample while Jun shakes her head.
Nara sets the pot down as Jun moves the sample away from the stove.
shots.narration: I reached for a pot. Jun stopped me before guesswork turned cloudy water into false confidence.

line.text: Boiling kills germs, not metals or particles.

shots.sfx: Pot lid rattle, faucet spit, low building creak.

shots.framing: Medium two-shot with Nara and Jun's faces fully visible beside separate water groups.
shots.background: Cool pantry shelf, sealed bottles on one side and cloudy containers isolated in a floor tray.
poses: Nara places a capped bottle beneath a label reading "RESERVED 7:26" while Jun checks the seal.
Jun marks the cloudy group "NON-DRINKING" as Nara moves it lower.
Nara leaves space between the two groups while Jun points to the separation.
Nara closes the pantry curtain halfway as Jun records the container count.
shots.narration: We reserved the earlier clear run as our best drinking supply, capped and dated—not proven safe, just lower risk.
shots.sfx: Marker stroke, bottle thump, curtain rings, distant pipe rumble.

shots.framing: Medium-wide two-shot with Nara and Jun's faces fully visible among empty rooftop fixtures.
shots.background: Empty nests, silent power lines, blue laundromat sign, rooftop tanks and gray Meridian skyline.
poses: Nara scans the skyline while Jun holds her headphones away from her ears.
Jun studies the silent wires as Nara looks into an empty nest.
Nara points toward another vacant rooftop while Jun checks her watch.
Jun turns toward the water tank as Nara notices its metal skin trembling.
shots.narration: With pressure falling, I followed Jun onto the roof. No wings crossed Meridian, and every nest stood empty.
shots.sfx: Wind over brick, soft rain, distant traffic stall, no birdsong.

shots.framing: Medium two-shot with Nara and Jun's faces fully visible beside the rooftop water tank.
shots.background: Riveted black water tank, emergency speaker pole, cup of water on the tank ledge and empty sky.
poses: Jun carefully sets the cup on the ledge while Nara watches the water surface.
Nara points at the first ripple as Jun starts timing on her watch.
Jun raises two fingers after the second ripple while Nara remains fixed on the cup.
Nara reacts to the third ripple as Jun stops her watch with a grim expression.
shots.narration: Jun balanced a cup on the tank. I watched its surface jump three times, exactly seventeen seconds apart.
shots.sfx: Three spaced tank knocks, cup tremor, watch click, light rain.

shots.framing: Medium two-shot with Nara and Jun's faces fully visible between the water tank and emergency speaker.
shots.background: Water cup, vibrating tank wall, emergency speaker horn and empty gray skyline.
poses: Nara turns toward the speaker as its relay clicks.
Jun points from her watch to the rippling cup.
Nara presses her palm to the tank as Jun counts another interval.
Nara and Jun exchange alarmed looks when speaker and tank move together.
shots.narration: Then I heard the emergency speakers click with every jump. The pipes were keeping their time.
shots.sfx: Speaker relay click, tank knock, cup ripple, seventeen seconds of tense wind between impacts.

shots.framing: Medium-wide three-shot with Nara, Jun and Lio's faces fully visible around the failing faucet.
shots.background: Kitchen sink, wall clock, sealed clear containers and uncovered cloudy containers.
poses: Nara raises one hand to stop filling while Jun checks the clock and Lio grips an empty bottle.
Nara caps a clear container as Jun isolates a cloudy one and Lio watches.
Jun closes the faucet while Nara moves the drinking supply away and Lio starts counting.
Nara points to the separated groups as Jun and Lio nod.
shots.narration: We had four minutes left. I chose less water: cap the clear containers, isolate the cloudy ones, stop chasing volume.
shots.sfx: Faucet coughing, fast cap clicks, clock tick, pipes grinding.

shots.framing: Medium two-shot with Nara and Lio's faces fully visible beside the water inventory.
shots.background: Cool shaded shelf, radiator across the room, household cleaner cabinet kept separate and two water groups.
poses: Lio counts sealed bottles while Nara moves them away from the radiator.
Lio writes "7 L RESERVED / 3 L SUSPECT" as Nara checks the lower tray.
Nara closes the cleaner cabinet while Lio compares his count with the shelf.
Nara rests one hand on the reserved water as Lio closes his notebook.
shots.narration: Lio counted seven drinking liters and three suspect. I moved both away from sunlight, chemicals, and the warm radiator.
shots.sfx: Pencil scratches, bottles shifting, radiator ticking, distant faucet cough.

shots.framing: Medium three-shot with Nara, Jun and Lio's faces fully visible beside a posted water rule.
shots.background: Red brick hallway, apartment doors, dim window and a clean sheet taped at eye level.
poses: Nara tapes up a sign reading "UNKNOWN WATER: DO NOT DRINK" while Jun holds the tape and Lio watches.
Jun underlines the sign as Nara points toward the pantry and Lio nods.
Lio copies the rule into his notebook while Nara and Jun check his wording.
Nara presses the sign flat as Jun and Lio look toward the groaning pipes.
shots.narration: I posted one rule: unknown water was never for drinking, cooking, teeth, or wounds until reliable testing cleared it.
shots.sfx: Tape ripping, pencil writing, pipe shudder, hallway window rattling.

shots.framing: Medium three-shot with Nara, Jun and Lio's faces fully visible around the silent sink.
shots.background: Dry steel faucet, organized sealed water, isolated cloudy samples and dark wall clock.
poses: Nara turns the faucet as one final sputter falls; Jun watches and Lio holds his notebook.
Nara releases the handle while Jun checks the dead stream and Lio looks at the stored water.
Jun places an empty glass beneath the dry tap as Nara folds her arms.
Nara looks toward the reserved bottles while Jun and Lio stand quietly beside her.
shots.narration: The taps coughed dry. We had stored a little carefully instead of storing a lot we might regret.
shots.sfx: Final faucet cough, one drain gurgle, pipes falling silent, rain at the window.

shots.framing: Medium two-shot with Nara and Jun's faces fully visible beside an emergency speaker.
shots.background: Wet speaker grille, abandoned nest, empty wires, rooftop tank and gray sky.
poses: Jun points to a feather caught in the speaker grille while Nara leans closer.
Nara steadies the speaker pole as Jun gently frees the feather.
Jun turns the feather under gray light while Nara notices its copper-glittering shaft.
Nara studies the feather with concern as Jun holds it away from her clothing.
shots.narration: Back upstairs, Jun found one abandoned feather stuck to a speaker grille. Its shaft glittered copper under the rain.
shots.sfx: Rain on speaker metal, feather scrape, distant tank knock, empty wind.

shots.framing: Medium two-shot with Nara and Jun's faces fully visible behind a clear water glass and open repair tin.
shots.background: Steel sink, clearest reserved sample, small electronics tools and rain-dark window.
poses: Nara places the clear glass beside the sink while Jun opens her repair tin.
Jun selects a tiny round magnet as Nara watches her gloved fingers.
Nara lifts the glass toward the light while Jun holds the magnet apart from it.
Jun looks directly at Nara before moving the magnet closer.
shots.narration: I carried our clearest glass to the kitchen. Jun took a tiny magnet from her repair tin.

line.text: This is not a safety test.

shots.sfx: Repair tin click, small tools shifting, glass set on steel, faint pipe hum.

shots.framing: Tight two-shot with Nara and Jun's full faces in the upper frame and the tap, glass and magnet large in the foreground.
shots.background: Steel faucet, dim kitchen tiles, reserved water shelf and rain-black window.
poses: Nara holds the clear glass beneath the tap while Jun keeps the magnet several centimeters away.
Jun slowly brings the magnet closer as Nara watches the still water.
Nara notices a faint copper thread near the faucet while Jun freezes her hand.
Jun moves the magnet beside the glass as Nara leans forward, eyes wide.
shots.narration: As the final tap dripped, I held the glass beneath it while Jun brought the magnet close.
shots.sfx: Single water drip, analog watch tick, low pipe vibration, glove creak.

shots.framing: Tight two-shot with Nara and Jun's full shocked faces above the glass and magnet in the foreground.
shots.background: Steel sink, dead faucet, dark tiles and trembling pipe.
poses: Nara stares as a hair-thin copper filament lifts through the clear water toward Jun's magnet.
Jun holds the magnet still while the filament bends sharply against the inner glass.
Nara's eyes widen as the copper filament snaps flat beside the magnet.
Jun looks toward the humming wall pipe while Nara holds the glass frozen.
shots.narration: On the seventeenth second, I watched the magnet pull a hair-thin copper filament against the glass. Subscribe to trace the filament.
shots.sfx: Tiny metallic tick, glass ring, deep pipe hum beginning, abrupt electrical click.
